summary: A ticketed ($71), self-supported gravel cycling ride series held at a reservation-only farm/forest retreat near Newland, NC, presented by WILDHAVEN Farm & Forest Retreat host Cass Bradley in partnership with Overmountain Cycles bike shop, benefiting the Northwest NC Mountain Bike Alliance. It reads as a recurring commercial/charity ride event rather than a club with a defined membership: riders register and pay per ride, with post-ride beer and food framed as "community" but no sign-up list, dues, or member roster.

evidence.note: Only 2 events over 4 months ($71 each), described as 'a self-supported ride series' with no membership language, sign-up form, or named regulars.

Eventbrite page confirms organizer is Cass Bradley/WILDHAVEN with Overmountain Cycles, calls it 'not a race - just a hard or good-vibes training ride' with post-ride beer/pizza, and says proceeds support the Northwest NC Mountain Bike Alliance nonprofit; no club structure or member roster is described.
The partnering bike shop's site has no mention of a 'Ridge Runout' club or riders group; only generic 'growing the ... community' language and a 'Shop Rides' page link.
